---
title: "Sluggers"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)
```

```{r}
Batting |>
  group_by(playerID) |>
  summarise(
    HR = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    first = min(yearID),
    last = max(yearID),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  slice_max(HR, n = 15, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  left_join(
    People |> select(playerID, nameFirst, nameLast),
    by = "playerID"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    player = paste(nameFirst, nameLast),
    steroid_era_activity = if_else(
      last >= 1994 & first <= 2009,
      "Active during steroid era",
      "Not active during steroid era"
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = HR, y = fct_reorder(player, HR), fill = steroid_era_activity)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not active during steroid era" = "#4E79A7",
      "Active during steroid era" = "#E15759"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Career Home Run Leaders",
    x = "Career home runs",
    y = "Player",
    fill = "Steroid era activity",
    caption = "Source: Lahman database"
  )
```

```{r}
Batting |>
  filter(playerID == "bondsba01") |>
  group_by(yearID) |>
  summarise(HR = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = yearID, y = HR)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Barry Bonds' Home Runs by Season",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Home runs"
  )
```
